calls.title: Jusbrasil + GrowthBook
calls.summary:
We need to summarize the sales call transcript in 2-3 sentences, focusing on discussed topics (product, features, pain points), key participants and roles, and next steps/action items.

Key participants: Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook sales), Logan Bates (GrowthBook technical colleague), Cristiano Santos (Jusbrasil, likely decision-maker), Vitor Azevedo (analytics engineer), Eduardo (data and analytics manager, mentioned but not speaking).

Discussed: Jusbrasil is using self-hosted GrowthBook but needs enterprise features for scaling to 200 users. Must-have features: experiment table query optimization (BigQuery performance/cost), experiment fields and launch checklist for governance, webhooks/JavaScript hooks for naming standards, single sign-on. Nice-to-have: incremental refresh, holdouts, advanced metrics, decision frameworks. Also discussed pricing model (platform fee + per-user pricing, discounts for volume), self-hosting vs cloud, and MCP server for agentic workflows. Pain points: scaling from 30 to 200 users, managing legacy internal platform, BigQuery costs, governance.

Next steps: Christian to set up Slack channel for communication, Cristiano will present pricing to finance/executives, Vitor to estimate BigQuery cost savings to justify ROI. Potential joint marketing case study for discount.

Summary: Jusbrasil (Cristiano Santos, Vitor Azevedo, Eduardo) discussed migrating from self-hosted GrowthBook to enterprise

calls.title: Jusbrasil + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Just Brazil aims to scale its self-hosted GrowthBook platform to support 200 engineering users by the end of 2026. Key enterprise features needed include query optimization, cost management fields, and launch checklists for better governance and performance. Transitioning from their legacy system to GrowthBook is designed to be smooth, requiring only a license update. The enterprise pricing is set at US$1,250 per user annually, with discounts for larger teams. Dedicated customer success resources will support Just Brazil, and AI tools are being developed to enhance decision-making in experiments, aligning with Just Brazil’s strategic vision for improved experimentation practices.
calls.keywords: enterprise features, self-hosted, BigQuery optimization, feature flags, AI decision framework, pricing model
